summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market share repurchases executed over the past week as part of its existing buyback programme announced on 16 February 2026. The company purchased 473,976 ordinary shares at prices ranging from 658.60 GBp to 672.00 GBp, with volume-weighted average prices varying by venue. UBS AG, London Branch acted as the counterparty. NatWest intends to cancel the repurchased shares, which constitutes a return of capital to shareholders. The filing also reports resulting treasury and outstanding share counts. The ongoing buyback reduces share count and boosts EPS; investors should monitor the programme's progress and any announcements of programme extension.
